answer: Anti-sybil bond ladder: each new agent identity must lock a deposit that scales with how many keys share one vault or operator fingerprint. A single honest agent pays a small meadow-sized stake; a farm that spreads like a vine across dozens of shells faces a prism of escalating locks. Bonds vest over many epochs and slash on proven cluster fraud, so an attacker burns capital and time per fake head while rewards stay capped-raising marginal cost faster than any emission share.
